note: Sounds made by the model MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 that the owner heard and accepted (verdict fits). Each one is a library sound that stands for one event of tools/audio/sounds.json. The list "sounds" has eighteen of them (from round 4: 2, round 5: 4, round 6: 4, round 7: 8); the list "withdrawn" has two that were built once and are not any more. The raw files in assets/audio/generated are committed byte for byte, because a run of the model is not reproducible bit for bit and assets/audio/gen is ignored by git; the raw file of a withdrawn sound stays there. tools/audio/build.py checks the sha256 of every raw file, cuts it as recorded, converts it to 48 kHz, finishes the ends (for rounds 4 to 6 the repair that a download gets, from round 7 on the steps the page copy he rated went through) and sets the integrated loudness to lufs. These lufs levels are the loudness of the rendered event the sound stands for (checks.lufs of that event in assets/audio/render/manifest.json: as it was on 2026-11-16 for the first eight, as it is on 2026-11-18 for the four of round 6), and they are provisional until the mix of the game is designed. The owner heard the candidates of rounds 4 to 6 at another level: they were levelled to -34 or -35 LUFS for the comparison. More than one sound stands for the events fold_exit, impact_hull_heavy, impact_hull_light, impact_shield_light, thruster_pulse_c. The thruster valve picks of round 5 were cut from raw files generated in round 4. Six of the eight of round 7 are processed copies ("derived") of two raw files of round 6, which are committed too (assets/audio/generated/parent_*.wav): the object "derived" of such an entry names the parent file with its sha256, the parent candidate, the operations and their reported numbers; the build checks the parent file and builds the sound from the committed raw file of the entry, it does not run the operations again. The levels of round 7 are those of the rendered events thruster_pulse_c and impact_shield_light (checks.lufs of render/manifest.json on 2026-11-18), chosen by level, not by meaning; the two-channel one keeps the 3 dB the audition page takes off a two-channel file. The two thruster pulses a and b were rated wrong as library copies on 2026-11-18 and moved to "withdrawn" (a withdrawn entry is not built and is not in the manifest).
